name: Afcons Infrastructure Limited
summary: A Shapoorji Pallonji company known for hard engineering — long bridges, tunnels, marine works and expressway packages.
ownership: Part of the Shapoorji Pallonji group; publicly listed
about: Afcons takes on the parts of a project other contractors would rather not: bridges over tidal water, tunnels through unstable rock, and foundations in places that are difficult to reach at all. On highways it builds expressway packages and the major structures along them. It works across India and in Africa and the Middle East, and is part of the Shapoorji Pallonji group.
facts: Specialises in bridges, tunnels, marine works and other difficult structures.
Part of the Shapoorji Pallonji group.
Works on expressway packages as well as metro and railway projects.
